description.value: Menbow Ramen Bar is a BC-based Japanese ramen chain with a mall-format location at Tsawwassen Mills. The kitchen uses key ingredients imported directly from Japan and employs Japanese-trained chefs, offering both creamy Tonkotsu and clear Tori broths across a range of classic flavors. Cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen area will find a full ramen menu with appetizers, online ordering, and third-party delivery available.

address.value: 5000 Canoe Pass Way, Tsawwassen, British Columbia V4M 0B3, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Tsawwassen Mills location at 5000 Canoe Pass Way, consistent with the OSM community tag. Takeout and delivery are confirmed via the 'Pick-Up & Delivery Options' section listing Skip The Dishes, Uber Eats, and Door Dash. A vegetarian option (Tomato Ramen) is explicitly noted in the About Us section; no bike-specific amenities, water refill, or washroom information appear anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Menbow Ramen Bar' but other mall-format locations on the website are branded 'Menbow Ramen Express'; the Tsawwassen Mills entry does not explicitly use either sub-brand name, so the OSM name may be slightly imprecise.
No phone number is listed for the Tsawwassen Mills location on the website, and OSM has no phone tag for this record.
Address was absent from OSM tags; the address used here (5000 Canoe Pass Way) is sourced from the website's Locations page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a confirmed Tsawwassen Mills location; useful stop for touring cyclists in the Tsawwassen area.
